  SUM(f.gross_amount) as web_sales_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date

  AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as order_count,
  MIN(f.gross_amount) as min_line_value,
  MAX(f.gross_amount) as max_line_value
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
